speaker: SPEAKER_00
transcript: Well, I agree. There are a lot of questions as to how this could even happen to begin with and how was a gunman able to reach the neighboring roof. It is a question that I actually asked when I was at the Wildwood, New Jersey rally where there were amusement rides right behind where he was on stage. And there were people riding the Ferris wheel. And I was thinking at that time, this can't be safe, you know? And the same questions are being asked now. And I think we will get to those answers as to, you know, who, we know that about the gunman, he was killed last night by the Secret Service. But there are questions as to what led to this is my understanding he put a threatening post up earlier in the day. And we do want to know how he gained access to that building and how he was able to be on that route. So still preliminary, we're waiting to hear more information. I imagine that the Secret Service will be coming in to Congress, not just brief us, but to also testify as to what occurred here, because it was a security failure. But we are thankful to the Secret Service agents who rushed President Trump off the stage and brought him to safety. And we also keep the family of the one spectator who was killed in our prayers, and hopefully the others that have been injured will survive. And it's just, I think, a real shocking thing that we are continuing to be concerned about.
